compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The test suite (about 19,200 nodes, 20 to 25 minutes for `make verify`) carries four classes of tests that assert nothing about behaviour. 37 modules (7,000 LOC, 486 nodes) pin one-time module splits as permanent invariants: re-export identity, "leaf" import shape, LOC floors, "shim no longer reachable"; 39 real behaviour tests are trapped inside them. `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` (1,890 LOC, 37 tests) re-asserts workflow config snapshots that its own docstring says collapsed into one reusable workflow, and duplicates `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` and `tests/unit/test_gerrit_docs_only.py`. 30 modules re-run a `scripts/check_*.py` gate over the real tree, or grep the Makefile for its invocation, although `make lint` (`Makefile:266-439`) already runs the script in CI. Two whole-tree AST import scans duplicate what ruff's `flake8-tidy-imports` (TID251/TID253, ruff 0.16.3) expresses natively; the remaining scans cannot be expressed and stay. `pytest-split` is pinned but `.test_durations` is git-ignored, so no duration profile exists. The operator approved retiring these classes (2026-09-06). Every verdict is enumerated per file and per test node, with node arithmetic, on origin/main 083620b0 in this epic's first comment. This epic touches only `tests/`, `scripts/`, `pyproject.toml`, `Makefile`, `.gitignore`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, and `docs/`, so it runs in parallel with the code epics.

Ratchet note: this epic creates no `tests/_*.py` helper, no check script, no workflow step, and no autouse fixture, so `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` throughout; `--update-stale` is not run here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The 24 seam/split guard modules beyond the 13 already classified are deleted and every trapped behaviour test collects at its named destination; 301 nodes deleted, 39 moved, 149 kept, reconciled from before/after collect runs. Checked in the seam story.
- [ ] `test_ci_workflow_parity.py` keeps 23 bug-anchored or shell-executing tests, one rewritten refspec test parametrized over the six reusable-workflow jobs, and nothing else; `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` runs from `make lint`. Checked in the parity story.
- [ ] Every `scripts/check_*.py` has exactly one owner: `make lint` runs it (the three CI-only scripts are added there) and no pytest module re-runs it against the real tree; `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py` is the single wiring census over all 28 lint-target scripts. Checked in the single-owner story.
- [ ] `TID251` (no `tests.`-rooted imports) and `TID253` (no module-level heavy-stack imports outside `src/rebar/_engine`) are enforced by ruff with a recorded red proof, and the two AST scans they replace are deleted. Checked in the ruff story.
- [ ] `.test_durations` is committed for the default selection with a key count equal to the collected node count, accepted by pre-commit, and documented in `docs/local-dev-env.md`. Checked in the durations story.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0 after each story.

## Child decomposition
- S1 delete the seam/split guard modules and move their behaviour tests: criterion 1.
- S2 collapse the CI-parity guards: criterion 2; depends on S1.
- S3 one owner per `scripts/check_*.py`: criterion 3; depends on S2.
- S4 fold the two expressible import scans into ruff: criterion 4; depends on S3.
- S5 record per-test durations once: criterion 5; depends on S4.
compiled_state.title: Retire the test suite's one-time seam guards and duplicate CI and lint oracles
